_doctrine: Coverage-accounting ledger + VEIN-MAP for book mining. TWO layers. (1) COMPLETENESS ACCOUNTING (Proposal A, 2026-07-07 -- read by the mining_coverage_accounted gate): makes WHOLESALE under-mining a red-board state AT COMPLETION instead of an invisible dropped thread (DDDL long tail; Immortality at 0 claims for ~40 sessions). Per book: mining_status incomplete|complete. A book flagged 'complete' must account for every source page (screenshot-scheme: every ===== Screenshot(N) ===== with zero claims in reviewed_empty {page: reason}) or every entry in sections[] (chapter-scheme: status mined|reviewed-empty, reviewed-empty needs a reason). 'incomplete' books are reported informationally, NEVER RED. Claim-bearing pages auto-derive from sealed locator.char_offset -> nearest ===== Screenshot(N) ===== marker. (2) VEIN-MAP (added G-3, 2026-07-09 -- the forward roadmap; NOT read by any gate, so it can never move the board): veins[] = the rich mineable regions per book (mine 100%) with kind, char/chapter region, home (tier-1 / search-only / editorial), status (pending|in-progress|mined|reviewed-empty) and progress. Non-vein filler is NOT listed here; it is dispositioned at completion via reviewed_empty/sections with a reason. The vein-vs-non-vein call stays human review discipline (.claude/rules/mining-veins.md); this layer just records the plan so no vein is forgotten and each mining session resumes where the last stopped. Regions were char-offset-verified against the sealed .txt this session. User is sole writer; NOT sealed, NOT a generated data artifact.
